name: 10pines-c6-tuslibros-iteracion1
title: TusLibros Iteration 1: Shopping Cart
description: First iteration of TusLibros.com: a shopping cart over the publisher's catalog that accepts books by ISBN with a quantity >= 1, rejects unknown ISBNs and invalid quantities, and lists its contents. Built from scratch with TDD.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C6 - Construccion de Software Seguro usando Test Driven Development

design.notes: Small greenfield model whose interest is in the validations (catalog membership, quantity >= 1) signalled with exceptions and in representing quantities per book without exposing the collection.
